observed_discontinuity: After virtual dispatch selects java.lang.Thread.start, Frozen Bubble GameView.<init> does not return. start runs GameThread.run on the calling thread, and the shared instruction budget is exhausted inside that loop.
required_semantics: start returns to its caller after the receiver thread has been started.
run makes progress independently of that caller.
A continuous run loop does not consume the caller's instruction budget.
Surface callbacks on the Activity thread are not inside the render loop.
isAlive and join observe that started thread.
Two Java threads do not share one current frame.

differences.description: API19 Thread.start calls VMThread.create. AGR native_thread_start calls dx_vm_execute_method on run and returns only when run returns. isAlive always returns false and join is a no-op.
differences.relevance: GameThread.run is while (mRun). The constructor calls setRunning(true) then start. The caller stays in run until the shared 500000-instruction budget is exhausted, so onCreate never finishes and surface callbacks do not run.

earliest_evidenced_divergence: API19 Thread.start calls VMThread.create so the receiver runs on its own thread. AGR native_thread_start executes run on the caller.

evidence.artifact: android-4.4.4_r2 libcore Thread.start is public synchronized void start and calls VMThread.create(this, stackSize). The method comment says the receiver runs on the receiver thread, not the thread that called start. GameThread.run in robinst/frozen-bubble-android GameView.java loops while (mRun) and calls lockCanvas only when surfaceOK is true.

Post-fix local probe of unchanged Frozen Bubble: VDISPATCH GameView.<init> pc 35 selects java.lang.Thread.start, then the log is Thread.start: running GameView$GameThread.run synchronously. The interpreter then reports instruction budget exhausted (500000) in GameThread.surfaceOK at pc 2, in GameThread.run at pc 30, in GameView.<init> at pc 38, and in FrozenBubble.onCreate at pc 42. start_activity returns -1. traversal_count, draw_count, and content_surface_created_count stay 0. This is not a first frame.

remaining_uncertainty: No independent Java Thread execution context exists yet, so isAlive and join were not remeasured against a live second context.
sleep inside run is unresolved and was not reached before the budget stop.
next_action: Do not implement a full scheduler in the dispatch repair. The next boundary is one guest Java Thread to one DEX execution context. Do not place that context on a guest pthread. Do not run a Simulator for this stop: onCreate dies before Surface callbacks. Do not implement lockCanvas or createScaledBitmap.
host_adaptation: DxVM.current_frame, stack_depth, pending_exception, insn_count, and the watchdog timestamp are VM-global and belong to the caller of dx_vm_execute_method. Register frames are per DxFrame but selected through the global current_frame. Inline caches live on DxMethod and are not safe for concurrent insert. The heap, class table, GC marks, interned strings, activity_instance, and framework_user are process-global. One guest pthread remains one Darwin pthread for GUEST-ARM native threads. A Java Thread is a host DEX execution context and must not alias that pthread table. This differential does not add that context.
